summary: Phase 2: Multi-project UI - project selector and creation flows

budget_impact.rationale: UI-only changes; no new model calls. Quick creation mode will trigger model calls in future phases when AI screening is implemented.
budget_impact.before: No project selection UI; placeholder toast for creation
budget_impact.after: Full project selector dropdown in header with switching; dedicated creation page with three modes (quick/manual/AI-guided). Manual and quick modes functional, AI-guided marked as coming soon.

checks.evidence: Core tests passed; HTTP tests blocked by sandbox (expected)

reviews.evidence: Visual review in Browser pane; code structure follows existing patterns

open_risks: Quick creation mode needs AI screening implementation (Phase 3)
AI-guided mode placeholder only - full implementation in Phase 3
Server cannot be tested in sandbox - requires non-sandboxed verification
Project selector UI complete but needs user testing for UX validation
